metadata.title: On the atomic decomposition of complete intersections in toric varieties
metadata.abstract: Building on Liu's and Liu--Sheshmani's systematized description of Kontsevich's localization methods in toric varieties, we develop a computational framework for genus-zero Gromov--Witten invariants of smooth projective toric varieties and their smooth complete intersections. This is grounded in equivariant localization and the combinatorial structure of toric fans. We describe how the geometric data required by the localization formulas can be recovered directly from the fan and extend the existing software for flag varieties to compute the small quantum multiplication by the first Chern class. The implementation also incorporates cyclic determinants and regularized-exponent multisets, providing computational tools for investigating the atomic decomposition of quantum cohomology. Using this framework, we obtain the nonrationality of every smooth complete intersection of a quadric and a cubic in $\mathbb{P}^5$. Also applying new methods to study Hodge atoms in Fano fivefolds, we recover the nonrationality of every smooth complete intersection of a quadric and a cubic in $\mathbb{P}^7$, due to Cavenaghi--Katzarkov--Kontsevich, and we prove the nonrationality of every smooth quartic double fivefold and every smooth quartic fivefold.
